title: tenant-surge-fuse-and-regional-bridging-hotpatch
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: A canary incident revealed tenant-level circuit transitions that were too aggressive during multi-region rolling restarts, causing cascading failovers for a small set of high-traffic tenants. This PR introduces a tenant 'soft fuse' that absorbs short-lived surges without tripping global load-shedding circuits, plus a regional-bridging fallback for critical tenants to avoid full failover when one region loses capacity. Design summary: 1) Soft fuse: per-tenant leaky-bucket counters with a time-decay window and a two-stage threshold (warning -> fuse). The fuse reduces allowed concurrency and applies a gentle token-rate cap rather than immediate eviction. 2) Regional bridging: if a tenant marked as 'critical' experiences degradation in region A and region B has spare capacity, requests are routed to B with a short-lived override policy that respects data residency flags. 3) Safety: an emergency admin toggle (api/v1/admin/surge_fuse) and a persisted, crash-safe fuse state backed by the existing kv/state-store to avoid flip-flopping during restarts. 4) Observability: new metrics (tenant_fuse_state, tenant_fuse_trips, regional_bridge_handoff) and a dashboard stub. 5) Hotfixes: fixes a race where fuse-state flush could lose the 'hysteresis' timestamp during rapid leader elections, previously observed during the canary. Checklist: - [x] Implement leaky-bucket with decay and hysteresis - [x] Implement regional bridging policy and residency checks - [x] Persist fuse state atomically to kv/state-store - [x] Add admin toggle & feature flag - [x] Add metrics and a basic Grafana dashboard JSON placeholder - [x] Add unit tests for fuse transitions and regional routing - [x] Add integration test that simulates rolling restart and verifies no cascading evictions Related linear items: ["ENG-5427", "SRE-311"] Related incident: SUP-2026-02-canary-3 Commits summary: - 9c4b2a3: Add tenant fuse leaky-bucket implementation and tests - 2f7d1e8: Add regional bridging policy and routing shim - 5a0e9f1: Persist fuse state to kv/state-store with atomic write path - 0c3d7b2: Add admin toggle, feature flag, and RBAC check - e1b9a4c: Add metrics, dashboard JSON, and integration test harness - 7f6b2aa: Fix race in leader election -> fuse hysteresis flush CI: initial run failed on integration test (timing flake); re-ran pipeline after adding 100ms backoff in leader handoff; all checks passed on second run. Merge decision: squash-merged after 2 approvals and green CI.

release_notes: Introduces tenant soft-fuse to reduce cascading evictions during short surges, and a regional bridging override for critical tenants. Adds admin toggle and observability metrics. Includes hotfix for fuse-state race during leader elections.
notes_for_ops: Ops: default soft-fuse is off; rollout is gated behind feature flag 'tenant_soft_fuse'. To enable for critical tenants set tenant.metadata.critical=true and flip admin toggle. If misbehavior is observed, disable admin toggle and run /admin/fuse/clear for affected tenant to reset hysteresis. Dashboard: infra/grafana/dashboard-tenant-fuse.json contains a starter dashboard. Watch metrics tenant_fuse_trips and regional_bridge_handoff.
merge_notes: Squash-merged on 2026-02-14 after CI green and 2 approvals. Post-merge: created rollout patch to enable soft-fuse in staging for 24h canary.
